resources.string: No-TUN core running · network reachability unverified
User-started continuous EasyTier overlay transport with a loopback SOCKS proxy, without using Android VPN. Must remain available while other apps use the existing VPN. Stops with the connection.
This candidate supports No TUN only. Select or import a No TUN profile.
No-TUN startup failed. Enable app notifications and the No-TUN notification channel, then retry. Also check the profile and whether another instance owns the SOCKS port.
The foreground service stopped. The core has been released; reconnect explicitly.
Core stop could not be confirmed. Check the candidate process before starting another instance.
